predictions.articleTitle: Bayer Leverkusen vs SC Paderborn 07 Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Home xG Crack Road Defense?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Bayer Leverkusen's superior expected-goal creation, restored frontline starters, and bench depth position them to secure a home victory in an open, multi-goal contest.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win — Leverkusen's 1.98 xG/game, 65.4% possession, and confirmed attacking core overpower Paderborn's 1.66 xGA/game defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals — Supported by Leverkusen's 88.9% Bundesliga Over 2.5 rate (4.11 total goals/game) and 3.11 lambda total (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
BTTS: Yes — Leverkusen's 22.2% clean-sheet rate and 1.75 xGA/game leave Paderborn a plausible counter-attacking scoring route (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Leverkusen's 1.98 xG attack tests Paderborn's injury-hit back three.

spf.comment: Bayer Leverkusen's 1.98 xG/game output, +212 Elo advantage, and confirmed frontline of Schick, Tella, Tillman, and Moreira point to a 2:1 or 3:1 home victory.

over_under.comment: Eight of Leverkusen's nine league matches (88.9%) cleared 2.5 goals, aligning with a 3.11 lambda total and Paderborn's 1.66 xGA/game.

btts.comment: Leverkusen's 22.2% clean-sheet rate and 1.75 xGA/game expose transition space for Paderborn to score once even while conceding multiple goals.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Paderborn's compact start before Leverkusen's quality tells, while 3:1 captures second-half expansion once the visitors chase.

goals.comment: Three goals is the modal 22.4% Poisson bucket and fits a 2:1 script, with four goals capturing Leverkusen's 4.11 goals-per-game league pace.

bqc.comment: Leverkusen lead 50% of home league games at the break (Win-Win), while Paderborn's 44.4% half-time draw rate makes a second-half surge (Draw-Win) the main alternative.
